# Iron ore

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-iron-ore.md" title="Iron ore"><img src="icons/9.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Iron ore"></a>

A finite underground deposit found at **Y −160 to 48**, with the strongest generation preference near **Y −48**. These are world heights, not depth below the surface. Ore replaces stone and does not regenerate after mining.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Required mining tool | Stone pickaxe or better |
| Placement | World block; cannot be placed directly as an inventory item |

## How to obtain

Find this deposit in stone. Mine it with a **stone pickaxe or better**.

Mining yields <a href="Item-raw-iron.md" title="Raw iron"><img src="icons/15.png" width="40" height="40" alt="Raw iron"><br>Raw iron</a> ×1.

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
